text:
```yaml
name: Index YouTube Playlist

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  index-youtube-playlist:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run YouTube playlist indexer
        run: npm run index-youtube-playlist

      - name: Deploy to Cloudflare R2
        env:
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID }}
          CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_KEY: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_KEY }}
          CLOUDFLARE_BUCKET_NAME: ${{ secrets.CLOUDFLARE_BUCKET_NAME }}
        run: |
          npx @cloudflare/r2 deploy --bucket $CLOUDFLARE_BUCKET_NAME dist/youtube

      - name: Update /youtube route
        run: npm run update-youtube-route

      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config --global user.name 'GitHub Actions'
          git config --global user.email 'actions@github.com'
          git add .
          git commit -m "Update YouTube playlist indexing"
          git push origin main
```
